settings.title: Importance of Caring for Your Cozyology Curtains
settings.text: Curtains are vital in adding beauty and functionality to your living space. At Cozyology Curtains, we emphasize the importance of caring for your curtains properly to preserve their high quality and extend their lifespan. Here's a detailed guide to maintaining your Cozyology curtains.

settings.title: When Should I Clean My Cozyology Curtains or Drapes?
settings.text:
• Deep Cleaning: Every 6-12 months is ideal, especially for heavily designed or intricate styles.
  • Routine Care: Vacuum every 2-4 weeks with an upholstery attachment to minimize dust and allergens.
  • Pet Hair: Use a lint brush or duct tape to control pet hair while vacuuming.

settings.title: Machine Wash at 30°C
settings.text: Curtains can be machine washed with a mild detergent, but the water temperature should not exceed 30°C (86°F).

settings.title: Dry Clean Drapes
settings.text: Suitable for dry cleaning with any solvent except trichloroethylene.

settings.title: Ironing Tips
settings.text: Iron at a low temperature setting (below 110°C/230°F). Place a thin cloth over the curtains to protect the fabric.

settings.title: Dos & Don'ts  of Fabric Care and Maintenance
Do Not Bleach
settings.text: Bleach can damage the fabric and color of the curtains.

settings.title: Do Not Tumble Dry
settings.text: Do not use a dryer. Air dry curtains, avoiding direct sunlight.

settings.title: Do Not Soak
settings.text: Always wash gently and avoid soaking for long periods to maintain fabric integrity.

Linen Curtains:

  • Pre-Treat Stains: Gently dab stains with cold water and mild detergent.
  • Cold Water Wash: Dry cleaning is recommended, or use a gentle cycle with cold water and mild detergent.
  • Drying: Hang naturally to air dry, or tumble dry on low heat to prevent shrinking.

Cotton Curtains:

  • Separate Colors: Wash lighter and darker shades separately.
  • Gentle Wash Cycle: Dry cleaning is recommended, or wash in cold water with a mild detergent.
  • Drying: Avoid tumble drying. Hang naturally to air dry.

Sheer Drapes:

  • Hand Wash: Use mild dish soap and gentle hand movements.
  • Rinse and Squeeze: Rinse thoroughly, then gently squeeze out excess water.
  • Air-Dry: Hang naturally to air dry. For extra care, use a liner and iron on low heat while damp.

Velvet Curtains:

  • Pre-Treat Stains: Gently dab with cold water and mild detergent.
  • Dry Cleaning: Dry cleaning is recommended.
  • Drying: Do not tumble dry.

Vacuum and Dust:

  • Short Strokes: Use short strokes with an upholstery brush or vacuum attachment.
  • Top-Down Cleaning: Start from the top and work downwards.
  • Regular Maintenance: Dust with a microfiber cloth for delicate fabrics.

Dry Cleaning:

  • Professional Care: Ideal for larger, heavily designed curtains.
  • Delicate Fabrics: Safe for all curtains, including linen, cotton, velvet, and sheer fabrics.

Steam Cleaning:

  • Manufacturer Instructions: Follow your steamer's guidelines.
  • Top-Down Motion: Clean in a top-down sweeping motion.
  • Test First: Test in an inconspicuous area to avoid discoloration.

Machine Washing:

  • Check Labels: Check fabric care to see if machine washing is recommended.
  • Cool Water Delicate Cycle: Use a gentle cycle with cool water.
  • Line-Drying: Line-dry or use a no-heat dryer setting to prevent shrinking.
